newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Briton arrested in Kuwait with illegal weapon.
newsitem.headline: Briton arrested in Kuwait with illegal weapon.

text.p: A British national has been arrested in Kuwait for the alleged illegal possession of an assault rifle, diplomatic sources said on Wednesday.
The British embassy in Kuwait "is closely monitoring the situation and is in contact with the man's family", an embassy spokeswoman said without giving any details.
Al-Watan daily reported on Wednesday that the Briton was "suspectd" of being a member of the Irish Republican Army (IRA).

It said he and a resident stateless Arab were arrested for allegedly smuggling and hiding an AK-47 rifle and ammunition in a new complex being built along the Gulf shore. The complex will be used by Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah and other officials.
Diplomats said the British embassy was trying to visit the detained Briton who resides in Kuwait with his wife.
